title: PractitionerSharedStatusResponse
description: A practitioner's shared credentialing status across the plans the caller can see: each plan's eligibility verdict and current credentialing workflow, and each anchor group's current shared workflow.

npi.description: The NPI that was looked up.

tenants.description: One entry per plan that has an eligibility verdict for the practitioner, sorted by plan name. Empty when the NPI is unknown or nothing is visible.

sharedWorkflows.description: Each visible anchor group's current shared workflow: the active one, else the newest. Empty when none exists.

status.description: The latest status event name as stored, normally a TimelineStatus name; NOT_STARTED when there are no events.

statusUpdatedAt.description: When the latest status event was written; null when there is none.

sharedCredWorkflowId.description: The shared workflow this workflow belongs to; null for the plan's own workflow.

reasonCode.description: Exclusion reason code; null when none is stored.

reasonDescription.description: Exclusion reason wording; null when there is no reason code.

PractitionerSharedStatusSharedWorkflow.description: An anchor group's current shared workflow.

anchorGroupId.description: The anchor group it belongs to.

active.description: Whether the shared workflow still accepts new tenants.

credentialingCycle.description: INITIAL or RECREDENTIALING; null until derived.

memberTenantIds.description: Tenant ids with a member workflow in it, withdrawn members included, sorted ascending.

PractitionerSharedStatusTenant.description: One plan's eligibility and current workflow.

tenantName.description: The plan's display name; null when it has none.

anchorGroupId.description: The anchor group the verdict sits in.

practitionerRegistryId.description: The registry practitioner behind the NPI.

participating.description: Whether the plan takes part in the shared workflow: the operator override when set, else true while the plan's current workflow is an unfinished member of a shared workflow, else whether it is eligible. True can also mean eligible to join, not yet a member.

currentWorkflow.description: The plan's current workflow; null when it has none.
